=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/cost_audit.py:66-67,180-184 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_NUM` now accepts comma-formatted token counts, but `_to_int` passes the raw string to `int()`, so values like `"100,000"` are silently parsed as `0`.
  WHY: That silently under-reports OpenRouter usage whenever a producer or log fixture emits comma-separated numbers; reviewers agreed the parser does not normalize the accepted format.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:66-79,180-184 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Placeholder values matched by `_NUM` (`na`, `null`, `none`, `-`, `?`) are converted to `0`, so unavailable usage data becomes indistinguishable from a real zero-token result.
  WHY: This preserves a fail-open parse but loses the distinction between "no data" and "zero usage"; one reviewer treated that behavior as intentional while others flagged it as a telemetry-accuracy gap.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:183-208 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The stderr JSON scanner keeps overwriting `usage` as it walks every JSON object and never breaks on the first valid match.
  WHY: When stderr contains multiple JSON payloads with `usage` dicts, the emitted `INFO: openrouter usage ...` line can reflect the last payload instead of the intended first one, corrupting telemetry.
- scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:144-147 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `normalize_openrouter_usage` now takes `phase_label` as a new second argument, shifting the old `(log_file, call_label, model_name)` call shape and risking mislabelled telemetry for any 3-arg callers.
  WHY: In-repo call sites were updated, but the helper is still a backward-compatibility hazard for copied wrappers or external consumers; one reviewer considered it low-risk because no current in-repo callers remain.
- scripts/cost_audit.py:798-804,837-906 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The Semble report format now adds `semble_contract_test=...` in the summary line and expands the Markdown tables with `contract_test_fallbacks`/`runtime_fallbacks`, changing the output shape.
  WHY: Downstream consumers that key on the old summary/table layout can misread or reject the new fields; reviewers differed on impact, but all treated it as a backward-compatibility risk.
